note: One example = the proofread transcript of the English TV commentary for a 3-minute window of one half. offset/duration are seconds in the SoccerNet half video; "entity" marks [player]/[team] mentions; "class" is the per-sentence type (the paper names three: scene description, background introduction, comment; the numeric mapping is not documented), several sentences merged give "1/1/1". "clip" names the segment clip used by the COCO-format captions. Videos are SoccerNet NDA, so no clip.
